en: Sepia-tone panoramic view of a small town set against low hills. In the foreground are agricultural fields, followed by a line of trees and village houses. On the hillside stand several larger buildings that look like villas or institutional structures. At the top left text reads "Zitzschewig", in the upper middle "Genesungsheim" appears near a large building on the slope, and on the upper right the hilltop is labeled "Wettinhöhe".
